meta.homeTitle: BIS CRS, ISI mark, HSN and IS standards
meta.homeDescription: Look up a product, HSN or IS number. Certko maps BIS CRS and ISI, BEE, G-Mark, CE, FCC, SABER and the labs that test them.

home.title: IS numbers, HSN codes and the lab behind them
home.subtitle: Look up a product the way a factory actually talks — IS 13252, HSN 8517, CRS or ISI. We show the scheme, the test cost, and how to file.
home.globeCaption: Phones, laptops, plugs, chargers, cars, ceramics and food — revolving inside
home.marketsTitle: If you are shipping outside India
home.step1Body: Open the product page. You get the standard, QCO status, CRS or ISI route, and the listed test range.
home.step2: See the live route, not a slogan
home.step2Body: CRS is Scheme II of BIS. Everything else on BIS is the ISI mark licence. Export marks (CE, FCC, G-Mark, SABER) sit next to that.
home.step3Body: Indicative test charges are listed. Ask Certko if the published range looks high — we work up to 30% under listed lab fees.
